Sasha: Quick follow-up from the PM — consolidated remediation items below. Need concrete owners + ETAs for the three P1 followups. Can folks claim? :clipboard:
Marta: I can take RED-4021 (kv-cache eviction tuning). Will dig in and post a short plan by EOD Wed.
Jordan: Thx Marta. For visibility, can you add acceptance criteria (metrics to show improvement)? e.g., p99 < 120ms for infer path.
Marta: Yep, adding acceptance criteria to the ticket now.
Tyler: I'll own RED-4033 (runbook + automation for failover). I'll create the Jira and link it here.
Tyler: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4033 — initial ticket created, estimate 3d, will draft playbook and a test checklist.
Neha: RED-4046 (capacity alert tuning) looks like it needs platform-side changes — I can be the backup reviewer, but need eng-infra primary.
Jordan: Suggestion: RACI for these three: RED-4021: R=Marta, A=Jordan, C=Eng-Infra, I=Oncall; RED-4033: R=Tyler, A=Jordan, C=SRE, I=Prod; RED-4046: R=Eng-Infra, A=Neha, C=Platform, I=Ops. Thoughts?
Sasha: That RACI looks good, Jordan. Can Eng-Infra confirm primary for RED-4046?
incident-bot: Automated reminder — follow-up owners should update Jira with due dates within 48h.
Marta: RED-4021 updated: added acceptance criteria + short rollout plan. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4021 ETA Wed-2024-06-12.
Tyler: RED-4033 updated with runbook stub and playbook checklist. ETA Mon-2024-06-17. Added a canary test step.
Neha: Pinging eng-infra channel for primary on RED-4046. @eng-infra please confirm.
Jordan: Noted recurring pattern: monthly cache-warmup spikes on the 1st of month — let's add a recurring eval to RED-4021 to prevent regression.
Sasha: Good call. Add a task in the ticket for monthly smoke check and link to metrics dashboard.
Marta: Done — added monthly smoke check and dashboard link.
Sasha: I'll own follow-up cadence: weekly check-ins until all three are closed, then monthly audit for 3 months. I'll post meeting invites. :calendar:
Tyler: Also added a short rollback plan to RED-4033 in case the automation misfires.
Neha: Eng-infra confirmed primary for RED-4046 (owner: Luis in eng-infra). Luis will post ETA by EOD tomorrow.
Sasha: Great — thanks everyone. If anyone needs handoff help, drop me a note and I'll pair with you.
Jordan: One more: let's tag the tickets with "postmortem-action" and assign to remediation board so they're visible to PMs and compliance.
Sasha: Done. I'll run a quick cross-check Friday and close the loop with the PM. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2024-06-14 to check progress on RED-4021/4033/4046.
